global_style: Cold, minimalist high-fashion editorial aesthetic; sterile lighting; tight, highly detailed close-ups; emphasis on micro-expressions and texture; subdued palette with a cerulean accent.

style_overrides.color_palette: cool, desaturated editorial tones with cerulean accent
style_overrides.architecture: modern corporate office with glass, chrome, minimalist lines

narrative_context.global_mood: Tense, freezing contempt; meticulous, intimidating scrutiny
key_events: Silent visual standoff between Miranda and Andy
Miranda’s dismissive voiceover defines the sweater as cerulean
narrative_context.cultural_context: High-fashion editorial hierarchy where precise color language signals expertise and power; junior assistants navigate exacting standards and silent authority.

characters.name: Miranda Priestly
characters.description: Imposing fashion editor with sleek silver bob, gold-rimmed glasses, razor-sharp gaze; immaculate high-end presence in a cold-toned office.
characters.clothing_style: Tailored couture suits, monochrome palettes, discreet luxury accessories (gold-rimmed glasses), heels.
characters.voice_description: Quiet, dismissive, precise; icy control with minimal inflection.
characters.personality: Cold, calculating, perfectionist; exacting authority; intimidating poise.
characters.backstory: Powerful fashion editor known for uncompromising standards; commands the room with silent dominance.
characters.current_motivation: Undercut Andy’s confidence and assert taste authority by dissecting her sweater’s color.

characters.name: Andrea "Andy" Sachs
characters.description: Nervous young assistant; anxious posture; lumpy, textured cerulean blue sweater; overwhelmed by Miranda’s piercing gaze.
characters.clothing_style: Lumpy cerulean sweater over basic office wear; practical, understated.
characters.voice_description: Soft, tentative; often silent under pressure.
characters.personality: Earnest, inexperienced, insecure; eager to learn, vulnerable to criticism.
characters.backstory: New to high-fashion editorial environment; lacks industry fluency; striving to fit in.
characters.current_motivation: Survive Miranda’s critique, retain dignity, and seek approval.

locations.name: High-End Fashion Office
locations.visual_style: Pristine, cold-toned, minimalist; glass and chrome surfaces; crisp, sterile lighting; executive desk and designer details; freezing atmosphere.
locations.narrative_function: Place of power; intimidation and critique.

props.name: Cerulean Blue Sweater
props.visual_description: Lumpy, textured knit in saturated cerulean; close-up reveals pilling and uneven texture; humble, out-of-place in an elite office.

props.name: Gold-Rimmed Glasses
props.visual_description: Thin gold-rimmed eyeglasses with elegant minimalist frames; catch the cold office light; emblem of authority and scrutiny.
